title: Confinement of Ti3C2Tx MXene Nanosheets within a Polymer Matrix via In-situ Polymerization and Deposition on Carbon Cloth for Supercapacitors
content: MXenes are 2D transition metal carbides and nitrides with the general formula Mn+1XnTx, where M represents a transition metal, n can be 1, 2, 3, X denotes carbon or nitrogen, and Tx refers to surface termination groups like –F, –OH, or =O [1,2]. Their graphene-like structure and interesting properties have made them a significant focus in materials science, with researchers investigating their potential for various applications [3,4].
